summary.plain: GRAPES-3 pairs 400 scintillator panels with a 560 square metre muon telescope in the Nilgiri hills of southern India. It studies cosmic rays and, through muons, space weather and thunderstorm electric fields.
summary.technical: Extensive air shower array at 2200 m, Ooty (11.4 N): 400 plastic scintillators of 1 m2 over 25,000 m2 and a 560 m2 tracking muon telescope (3,712 proportional counters in 16 modules, 1 GeV threshold); designed for TeV-PeV gamma and cosmic rays. Continuous muon-telescope operation since 2000.
